targets.title: The price of expertise: Effects of experience on the water-level task.
targets.evidence_quote: This is a registered report to directly replicate the primary finding in Hecht and Proffitt (1995).
targets.outcome_quote:
We failed to replicate Hecht and Proffitt’s results, finding that their study had less than 33% power to detect the
                       small, nonsignificant difference that we observed between groups.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict. The limited power mentioned is that of the original study, not a verdict that this replication was uninformative.
